description: Source code implementing 1D tensor convolution operations (forward and backward) for TBC (Time-Batch-Channel) tensors in PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: conv_tbc
methods.description: Performs 1D convolution on time-batch-channel tensors with specified padding, returning the convolved tensor.

methods.name: conv_tbc_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients of input, weight, and bias tensors for the conv_tbc operation during backpropagation.
